items.text: Kwathi uJesu eseqedile wonke lamazwi, wathi kubafundi bakhe:
Liyazi ukuthi emva kwensuku ezimbili kuzakuba liPhasika; iNdodana yomuntu izakunikelwa ukuba ibethelwe.
Kwasekubuthana abapristi abakhulu labadala besizwe egumeni lompristi omkhulu othiwa nguKayafasi.
Bacebisana ukuba bambambe uJesu ngobuqili, bambulale.
Kodwa bathi: Kakungabi ngesikhathi somkhosi, funa kube khona isiphithiphithi ebantwini.
Kwathi uJesu eseBethani endlini kaSimoni owayelobulephero,
kwafika kuye owesifazana ephethe umfuma wamagcobo abiza imali enengi, wawathela ekhanda lakhe ehlezi ekudleni.
Luka 7:37
Kodwa abafundi bebona lokhu bathukuthela, bathi: Achithelwani lamagcobo na?
Ngoba ngabe athengisiwe ngemali enengi, kwanikwa abayanga.
Kodwa uJesu ekwazi lokhu wathi kibo: Limhluphelani owesifazana na? Ngoba wenzile umsebenzi omuhle kimi;
ngoba abayanga lihlala lilabo, kodwa mina kalihlali lilami.
Dute 15:11
Ngoba ngokuthela amagcobo emzimbeni wami, wenzela ukungilungisela ukumbelwa.
Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Loba ngaphi emhlabeni wonke lapho okuzatshunyayelwa khona ivangeli, lokho akwenzileyo kuzakukhulunywa ngakho, kube yisikhumbuzo ngaye.
Omunye wabalitshumi lambili othiwa nguJudasi Iskariyothi waya kubapristi abakhulu,
wathi: Lizakunginikani aluba ngimnikela kini na? Basebemnika inhlamvu zesiliva ezingamatshumi amathathu.
Kusukela ngalesosikhathi wafuna ithuba lokumnikela.
Ngosuku lokuqala lomkhosi wesinkwa esingelamvubelo abafundi beza kuJesu bathi: Uthanda ukuba sikulungisele ngaphi ukuba udle iPhasika na?
Wathi: Hambani liye emzini kumuntu othile, lithi kuye: UMfundisi uthi: Isikhathi sami sesiseduze; ngizakwenza iPhasika kwakho kanye labafundi bami.
Benzake abafundi njengokuba uJesu ebalayile; balungisa iPhasika.
Kwathi sekuhlwile, wayehlezi ekudleni labafundi abalitshumi lambili.
Besadla, wathi: Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Omunye wenu uzakunginikela.
Badabuka kakhulu, bathi kuye ngamunye: Kungaba yimi, Nkosi na?
Waphendula wathi: Otshebe kanye lami emganwini nguye ozakunginikela.
Hubo 41:9
INdodana yomuntu ihamba njengokulotshiweyo ngayo, kodwa maye kulowomuntu enikelwa nguye iNdodana yomuntu! Bekungangcono aluba wayengazalwanga lowomuntu.
Wasephendula uJudasi owamnikelayo, wathi: Impela kungebe yimi, Mfundisi? Wathi kuye: Kutsho wena.
Besadla uJesu wathatha isinkwa, wabonga, wasihlephula, wabanika abafundi bakhe wathi: Thathani lidle; lokhu kungumzimba wami.
Wathatha inkezo, wabonga, wabanika, wathi: Nathani lonke kuyo;
ngoba lokhu kuligazi lami lesivumelwano elichithelwa abanengi ukuthethelelwa kwezono.
Eks 24:8
Ngithi kini: Kusukela khathesi kangiyikunatha lesisithelo sevini kuze kufike lolosuku lapho ngizakusinatha lani sisitsha embusweni kaBaba.
Kwathi sebehlabele ingoma baphuma baya entabeni ethiwa iOliveti.
UJesu wasesithi kibo: Lina lonke lizakukhubeka ngami ngalobubusuku, ngoba kulotshiwe ukuthi: Ngizakutshaya umalusi, izimvu zomhlambi zichitheke.
Zek 13:7
Kodwa ngemva kokuvuswa kwami ngizakulandulela ukuya eGalili.
UPetro wathi kuye: Lanxa bezakhubeka bonke ngawe, mina angisoze ngikhubeke.
UJesu wathi kuye: Ngiqinisile ngithi kuwe: Ngalobubusuku, lingakakhali iqhude, wena uzakungilandula kathathu.
UPetro wathi kuye: Loba ngingaze ngife lawe, kangiyikukulandula. Batsho njalo bonke abafundi.
UJesu wasefika labo endaweni ethiwa yiGetsemane; wathi kubafundi: Hlalani lapha, ngisayakhuleka laphaya.
Wathatha uPetro lamadodana amabili kaZebediya, waqala ukudabuka lokukhathazeka kakhulu.
Wasesithi kibo: Umoya wami udabukile kakhulu kungathi ngingaze ngife; hlalani lapha, lilinde lami.
Waqhubeka ingcosana, wawa phansi ngobuso bakhe, wakhuleka wathi: Baba, uba kungenzeka, kakudlule kimi linkezo; kodwa kungabi njengokuba ngithanda mina, kodwa njengokuba uthanda wena.
Weza kubafundi, wabafumana belele; wathi kuPetro: Kanti belingelinde lami iawa ibenye na?
Lindani, likhuleke ukuze lingangeni ekulingweni; umoya uyavuma, kodwa inyama ibuthakathaka.
Wabuya wasuka ngokwesibili, wakhuleka wathi: Baba, uba inkezo le ingedlule kimi ngingayinathanga, kayenziwe intando yakho.
Wabuya futhi, wabafumana belele, ngoba amehlo abo ayenzima.
Wabuya wabatshiya, wahamba, wakhuleka ngokwesithathu esitsho wona lawomazwi.
Weza kubafundi, wathi kibo: Lisalele liphumula na? Khangelani, isikhathi sesisondele, iNdodana yomuntu iyanikelwa ezandleni zezoni.
Sukumani sihambe. Khangelani, onginikelayo useseduze.
Kwathi esakhuluma, kwafika uJudasi, omunye wabalitshumi lambili, elexuku elikhulu liphethe imihedla lezinduku, livela kubapristi abakhulu labadala besizwe.
Omnikelayo wayebanike isiboniso sokuthi: Lowo engizakumanga, nguye, limbambe.
Wasondela kuJesu masinyane wathi: Okuhle, Mfundisi! Wamanga.
UJesu wathi kuye: Mngane, yenza lokho oze ukukwenza. Basebesondela, bamdumela uJesu, bambamba.
Khangela, omunye walabo ababeloJesu welula isandla, wakhokha umhedla wakhe, wageca inceku yompristi omkhulu, wayiquma indlebe.
UJesu wasesithi kuye: Buyisela umhedla wakho endaweni yawo, ngoba bonke abaphatha umhedla bazakubhubha ngomhedla.
Kambe uthi ngingencenge uBaba ukuba angithumele masinyane izimpi zezithunywa ezidlula itshumi lambili na?
Pho, ingagcwaliseka kanjani imibhalo ethi kumele ukuba kube njalo na?
Ngalesosikhathi uJesu wathi emaxukwini: Liphume lemihedla lezinduku ukuzangibamba kungathi ngingumphangi na? Bengihlezi insuku ngensuku ethempelini ngifundisa, kodwa kalingibambanga.
Luka 19:47
Kodwa konke lokhu kwenzakele ukuba kugcwaliseke imibhalo yabaprofethi. Basebemtshiya bonke abafundi, babaleka.
Ababembambile uJesu bamqhuba bamusa kuKayafasi umpristi omkhulu lapho babebuthene khona ababhali labadala.
Kodwa uPetro wamlandela ekhatshana, kwaze kwaba segumeni lompristi omkhulu; wangena phakathi, wahlala phansi lezinceku ukuba abone isicino.
Abapristi abakhulu lomphakathi wonke bafuna ubufakazi bamanga ngoJesu ukuze bambulale;
kodwa kababufumananga, lanxa kwavela ofakazi abanengi bamanga. Emva kwalokho kwavela ababili,
bathi: Lumuntu wathi: Ngilamandla okudiliza ithempeli likaNkulunkulu, ngibuye ngilakhe ngensuku ezintathu.
Joha 2:19
Kwasekusukuma umpristi omkhulu, wathi: Kawuphenduli lutho na? Kuyini lokhu abakufakaza ngawe laba na?
Kodwa uJesu wathula. Umpristi omkhulu wathi kuye: Ngikufungisa uNkulunkulu ophilayo ukuba usitshele uba unguKristu, iNdodana kaNkulunkulu.
UJesu wathi kuye: Kutsho wena. Kodwa ngithi kini: Kusukela khathesi lizakubona iNdodana yomuntu ihlezi ngakwesokunene saMandla, isiza ngamayezi aphezulu.
Dan 7:13
Umpristi omkhulu wasedabula ingubo zakhe, wathi: Usehlambazile. Sisafunelani ofakazi na? Khangelani, seliyizwile inhlamba.
Levi 24:16
Lithini na? Baphendula bathi: Ufanele ukufa.
Basebemkhafulela ngamathe ebusweni, bamdutshuza, labanye bammakala,
Isa 50:6
bathi: Sitshele Kristu! Ngubani okutshayileyo na?
UPetro wayehlezi ngaphandle egumeni; kweza kuye intombazana, yathi: Lawe ubuloJesu waseGalili.
Kodwa walandula phambi kwabo bonke, wathi: Kangikwazi lokho okutshoyo.
Kwathi esephumele esangweni, enye intombazana yambona, yathi kwababemi khona: Lumuntu ubeloJesu waseNazaretha.
Wabuya walandula wafunga esithi: Kangimazi lumuntu.
Emva kwesikhatshana labo ababemi khona basondela, bathi kuPetro: Impela ungomunye wabo, ngoba ukukhuluma kwakho kuyakuceba.
Waseqala ukuthuka lokufunga, wathi: Kangimazi lumuntu. Lahle lakhala iqhude.
UPetro wasekhumbula ilizwi likaJesu lokuthi: Lingakakhali iqhude, uzakungilandula kathathu. Waphumela ngaphandle, wakhala ngokudabuka okukhulu.
